name: taskmaster-mods
description: Taskmaster in the terminal: review queue, this session's current task above the prompt, handovers pane, faults-only status line.

source.title: Data source
source.description: tm reads the Taskmaster MCP server; demo draws built-in sample data (screenshots and tuning without a backlog).

reviewScope.title: Review queue scope
reviewScope.description: waiting: in-review tasks that name a human action (the sign-off state). all: every in-review task, pre-protocol ones included.

reviewPhase.title: Review queue phase
reviewPhase.description: A phase id to limit the review queue to, as the board's phase filter does. Empty for every phase.

handoverGuard.title: Cache-cold handover guard
handoverGuard.description: After the idle minutes below with a big context and no handover yet this session, once, before the 1-hour prompt cache expires: get a handover written, then (optionally) compact. How is set by the two options below; nothing is compacted without its handover. Arms from the next turn end after enabling or a reload.

handoverGuardFork.title: Handover guard: write from a fork
handoverGuardFork.description: On: a fork of the conversation drafts the handover and the mod files it, so the conversation itself is never prompted. Off: the conversation is asked to write it with the taskmaster:handover skill.

handoverGuardCompact.title: Handover guard: compact afterwards
handoverGuardCompact.description: On: once the handover is written, the session is compacted with instructions naming it (without a fork, right after the guard's own turn ends; a prompt of yours before then cancels it). Off: the handover only.

handoverGuardMaxRefreshes.title: Handover guard: cache refreshes while agents work
handoverGuardMaxRefreshes.description: While subagents or a workflow still work, the guard never hands over or compacts; it re-reads the cached context instead (a cheap tool-less fork) so the cache stays warm. At most this many refreshes in a row (6 ≈ 5.5 hours at 55 min); then the cache is left to go cold. 0 never refreshes.

handoverGuardIdleMinutes.title: Handover guard: idle minutes
handoverGuardIdleMinutes.description: Minutes idle after a turn before the guard asks (at most 57; the cache expires at 60).

handoverGuardMinTokens.title: Handover guard: minimum context tokens
handoverGuardMinTokens.description: The guard asks only when the context holds at least this many tokens. The 200000 default targets 1M-context models: on a 200k window auto-compact acts first.

briefModel.title: Restore brief model
briefModel.description: The model the restore pane's Brief asks for a state / next / blocker summary of a closed session: an alias or a full model id.
